The main takeaway from our work is that
, despite its isolated location, WLM's metallicity distribution and gradient is similar to the Magellanic System and dSphs of comparable mass.

the global metallicity and metallicity spread observed in WLM are consistent with expectations based on its mass, and the spatially resolved metallicity distribution is consistent with expectations based upon the galaxy's angular momentum.
